annotations.summary: A schedulable node has been NotReady for 10 minutes. Everything on it has been rescheduled or is stranded.
A node is running out of root disk. This is the most common way this cluster falls over.
A PersistentVolumeClaim is nearly full. local-path volumes cannot be expanded — that one needs a migration, not a resize.
A CronJob's next scheduled run passed over an hour ago and never happened. Covers renovate, duckdns, money and the smitele-bot collectors.
A Job reached terminal failure without a later successful CronJob run or full namespace backup. Retained recovered failures and failed retry pods do not fire.

model.expr: (((max by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_failed{cluster="home-k3s",condition="true"}) == 1) unless on (namespace, job_name) ((max by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time{cluster="home-k3s"}) * on (namespace, job_name) group_left(owner_name) max by (namespace, job_name, owner_name) (kube_job_owner{cluster="home-k3s",owner_kind="CronJob",owner_is_controller="true"})) < on (namespace, owner_name) group_left() label_replace(max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{cluster="home-k3s"}), "owner_name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.+)"))) unless on (namespace, job_name) ((max by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time{cluster="home-k3s"}) and on (namespace, job_name) max by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_owner{cluster="home-k3s",owner_kind="Backup",owner_is_controller="true",job_name!~".*-prebackup"})) < on (namespace) group_left() max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_completion_time{cluster="home-k3s"} and on (namespace, job_name) max by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_owner{cluster="home-k3s",owner_kind="Backup",owner_is_controller="true",job_name!~".*-prebackup"})))) or on (namespace, job_name) (0 * max by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_failed{cluster="home-k3s",condition="true"}))

annotations.summary: CrowdSec crossed more scenario thresholds in 15 minutes than a normal day produces. Detection only — nothing was blocked.
CrowdSec is failing to parse the Traefik log. Detection has effectively stopped, and the security dashboard will look reassuringly empty.
A public certificate expires in under 14 days.
A public hostname has failed its probe for 5 minutes. Includes the Minecraft and Jellyfin VPS relays, which have no other monitoring at all.
cloudflared has zero HA connections to the Cloudflare edge. Every diemer.codes hostname is unreachable while the cluster itself looks healthy.
No logs have reached Grafana Cloud in an hour. Alloy fails pushes silently — Running proves nothing — so a flat line here is the only symptom.

title: Active series approaching the free-tier cap

annotations.summary: Active series are above 8k of the 10k free-tier cap. Once it is hit, Grafana Cloud refuses new series and the gaps look like broken exporters.
More than 5% of requests to a hostname are failing with 5xx.

model.expr: max(100 * sum by (RequestHost) (count_over_time({cluster="home-k3s", app="traefik", DownstreamStatus=~"5.."}[10m])) / sum by (RequestHost) (count_over_time({cluster="home-k3s", app="traefik"}[10m])))

annotations.summary: SMS phone gateway is unavailable. The relay cannot reach the authenticated Android gateway API; SMS delivery may be stopped.
annotations.description: Check the phone Wi-Fi address and local SMS Gateway server. See docs/sms-gateway-recovery.md. This check does not send a test SMS.

annotations.summary: No home cluster scrape heartbeat has reached Grafana Cloud for at least 10 minutes.
annotations.description: Possible cluster power, Internet, tunnel, or Alloy outage. Grafana Cloud sends critical email independently of the home ntfy/SMS relay.

annotations.summary: Notification delivery needs attention: ntfy unavailable, SMS fallback selected, messages queued over 10 minutes, or failures within the last hour. Delivered phone messages are not inferred from ntfy acceptance.

model.expr: label_replace((home_relay_oldest_pending_seconds{cluster="home-k3s"} > bool 600), "check", "queue", "", "") or label_replace((home_relay_failed_last_hour{cluster="home-k3s"} > bool 0), "check", "failed", "", "") or label_replace((home_relay_fallback_last_hour{cluster="home-k3s"} > bool 0), "check", "fallback", "", "") or label_replace((home_ntfy_healthy{cluster="home-k3s"} < bool 1), "check", "ntfy", "", "")

annotations.summary: An application health exporter is missing or cannot complete its check. Monitoring may be blind; inspect the affected target.

model.expr: (up{cluster="home-k3s",job="prometheus.scrape.home_health"} == bool 0) or absent(home_ntfy_healthy{cluster="home-k3s"}) or absent(home_relay_oldest_pending_seconds{cluster="home-k3s"}) or absent(home_arr_health_issues{cluster="home-k3s",app="sonarr"}) or absent(home_arr_health_issues{cluster="home-k3s",app="radarr"}) or absent(home_arr_health_issues{cluster="home-k3s",app="prowlarr"}) or absent(home_gateway_connected{cluster="home-k3s",namespace="claude"}) or vector(0)

annotations.summary: No successful full namespace backup in nine days. Weekly cadence plus two days grace; inspect K8up schedules and repository.
Cannot read K8up backup/schedule status; backup freshness is unknown.
Deployment has fewer available replicas than requested for ten minutes.
StatefulSet has fewer ready replicas than requested for ten minutes.
DaemonSet is missing ready pods on expected nodes for fifteen minutes.
Container has remained in a startup failure state for ten minutes.
Container restarted at least twice in thirty minutes and its last termination was OOMKilled. Inspect memory limits and workload growth.

model.expr: (sum by(namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster="home-k3s"}[30m])) * on(namespace,pod,container) max by(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="home-k3s",reason="OOMKilled"})) or vector(0)

annotations.summary: Messaging transport disconnected for five minutes. WhatsApp reports its live session; Signal reports the local signal-cli connection. Check pairing and daemon receive errors.
Arr reports persistent health warnings/errors. Inspect System > Status for indexer, download-client, or configuration details. Routine downloads do not notify.
